The wrap is only safe when the lap start, end and length agree (an incoherent length lets walk 1 drift out of the array), so the lap is fixed at records 0..7 (start 0x8943a0, end base+0xb00, length 0xb00); pit start 9..10 and pit end 12..14 vary as in ring_00405a12.
